Knee support.
Built in India.

Konarc is an Indian startup developing mechanical knee support for people living with arthritis and other knee problems.

What we’re building

Our first product is a knee sleeve with adjustable mechanical screws and straps.

We’re developing a companion app that connects with multiple sensors in the sleeve. A future product will explore integrated TENS for pain management.
